name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkulrl4imofrpc3ql15p30r3rijmogn49ds3eh30_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6o5ic1qm1d1l6ppmao3m6orr9dj5clq71p5me1qb6obimlgjedj361rb3db3m3jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8omcs5kmkq3fdj4coor1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqt16kufaqjivq2sqvmu0n8hvr98hd4mg1mb44bg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrhi2537pnfuthu6np3hp96u0o94hjoumur7tr9o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znplhu17ehp2mcjiiv03rqrbanpjd8vq0o7fn3v0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zju5d9p317ji27e7qo59nc57q2kjf9h66qqcg2rg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zveboaje6311lptvhnom25ultvehoq5edvabfs9o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqm2eidoa575bdj0kjdb9fl1hqeoj67ggg6316n0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8qskquuhrkov8mtt0buveba43ojssouh5s5ra10_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn6r44jic9tfqodppepmhtishn9reohl2oj4mje0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq6sjs7aeh7gb44njboobkrdkbd290hnsg9n2mvo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfsdu6fiu1kmcucgu067rg48a8049udalhhpv74o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrc0e2o038gtgj92e5aug67g8sncagk4tqfhn6t8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztl729nk9g4vv2llj4deruldjmusp1hook7jalh0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztk44a715tujbbg3h5mgeamm54dbeg60kcc45hfg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztk42l7vn0mig6k1se49v4s5u4rek430rn5e7gr0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z36pq0faraa1d1eo9fpr4sn0gskk7gt172ct76fo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvdp4qeh3f30fotlrk6hcds1g63dtu6i3jlsj828_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z66ofup6bh1u09c44ksneq57vgasc3sjcak6bbag_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf59ak4q4h5ck5hr8f5hreiohqgscp9bolaoi598_rp22sh2s8i66pb4shieao31clh2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48540475/358651311/534296935?refcode=EM_FR_220729EOM_EOM_TLBR_90DO_4_NG_N_TESTA_logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZjYwMzc2MC0xZDEwLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XsBf81Q1luFDGjYB9Xj_8j7LsmLty48wslTTvOuOIlc=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48540476/358651312/534296935?refcode=EM_FR_220729EOM_EOM_TLBR_90DO_4_NG_N_TESTA_logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjg3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZjYwMzc2MC0xZDEwLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XsBf81Q1luFDGjYB9Xj_8j7LsmLty48wslTTvOuOIlc=) Team, we’ll make this quick. Lisa’s congressional race will drive turnout in this year’s election, and with critical positions on the line for Democrats down the ballot, we cannot afford to take that lightly. ---
| ,

A recent non-partisan investigation into the effectiveness of “Project Homekey” (California’s billion-dollar program to place the homeless in permanent housing) showed that the project is actually _**failing.**_

Conversely, what they found out is that under this current administration, we’ve seen the homeless crisis grow increasingly worse year by year.

While the Newsom administration has been boasting that Homekey is setting records for its effectiveness, [this recent study proved the opposite. ](https://briandahle.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=11c7ad6aa59a7d39fc5819cc1&id=2823145139&e=f9133ea432)

Three key points they discovered were:

1) Rather than moving people off the streets, federal data shows that the number of sheltered homeless grew by 3,541 in 2021!

2) Homeless populations are growing, not declining, despite billions of dollars spent.

3) Homelessness in California is growing while homelessness in the nation is declining.

Meanwhile, Newsom is campaigning on the slogan that “California is leading the way.”

The opposite is more true.

California is failing on every major issue under his leadership.

It’s time for change.

We don’t have to live in a constant state of crisis.

It’s time to restore hope for a better California.

\- Senator Brian Dahle.

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Honoring our veterans, and the country they fought to defend, should be about the policies we pass to support them and not just the pretty speeches made during election season.
body:
Talk is cheap
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **" If that's America First, then we're f*ked."** This is what former _The Daily Show_ host Jon Stewart had to say about the _deplorable_ Mitch McConnell and his Republican Senate colleagues. Just after they discarded our veterans like garbage, by _ filibustering a bill to provide funding for veterans suffering ailments due to their exposure to toxic burn pits while in Iraq and Afghanistan._ Republicans line up to send our soldiers to war, but when they come home with ailments suffered from fighting those wars, **_Mitch McConnell lies to their faces them in the faces, says "we'll get it done," just before heartlessly block a bill that only a month ago had 84 votes in the Senate, including his. Utterly repulsive._** Stewart best described McConnell and his gang: _America’s heroes, who fought our wars, outside sweating their asses off, with oxygen battling all kinds of ailments, while these motherf**kers sit in the air conditioning walled off from any of it? They don’t have to hear it. They don’t have to see it. They don’t have to understand that these are human beings. Did you get it yet?”_ We have incredible Democratic veterans representing us in Congress. **For example, Rep. Elaine Luria of Virginia, who served with distinction in the Navy, and who now endures misogyny and death threats to courageously served on the January 6th Committee--to protect our country from enemies at home as she has from enemies abroad.**

Really all of us, as they sit in their "air conditioned offices" and we're out in the heat. **_Let's send a message by supporting the best among us, Rep. Elaine Luria, who served this country, and still serves it with honor and courage on the Jan 6h Committee today. _**
## [**_Will you join me in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Congresswoman Luria?_**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T75c737e2-dd05-4580-8d13-50bdee9cc17d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Derek Kilmer
subject: I will never stop fighting for you.

body:
Investing in our communities:
Peter,

As a member of the House Appropriations Committee, I have the opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping the investments our government makes. I'm proud to have secured recent investments that will make a difference in our community, boost our economy, and create jobs.

Here are just a few important wins for our region I was honored to support:

_**Investing in Jefferson County Infrastructure Projects**_
Our region needs more affordable housing -- period. That's why I'm proud these investments will go toward building affordable housing in Port Townsend and Port Hadlock and service residents at essential community locations.

_**Securing Additional Federal Funding to Support the Aberdeen-Hoquiam Flood Protection Project**_
Our coasts are vulnerable to severe flooding due to weather-related events, king tides, and rising sea levels. These additional federal investments will build two levees to help protect the cities of Aberdeen and Hoquiam against coastal flood events. It will also enable more investment in affordable housing and economic development in the region - and save local residents millions of dollars in flood insurance costs.

_**Securing New Funding to Support Kids and Families**_
There is no better investment we can make for our future than one that benefits our children. I'm proud to have secured new investments to help rural, under-resourced regions with nutrition assistance, early childhood education, and community and parent engagement.

_**Advancing New Federal Funding to Improve Health Care for Tribes on the North Olympic Peninsula**_
The federal government has an obligation to fulfill its trust and treaty responsibilities and to make sure people have the resources they need to live healthy lives. That's why I'm proud the Appropriations Committee has made progress to provide critical funding to advance projects that I advocated for which will make a big difference for Tribes on the Olympic Peninsula, including new health centers for the Makah Tribe and investments for the Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe.

_**Helping Expand and Modernize the Port of Grays Harbor and Support Local Fishermen**_
Our coastal fisheries and seafood industry are an essential part of our region's economy. That's why I'm committed to ensuring our ports and our fishermen have the resources they need to remain competitive in the Pacific Northwest. This is about jobs. I'm thrilled the House Appropriations Committee has advanced new funding I fought for to help modernize the Westport Marina and support local economic opportunities.

Peter, I will never stop fighting for the folks all across our district and our region. The support from this grassroots team is integral to this work and is just one of the many reasons why I am grateful to advocate for you and our neighbors.

**[But there's more work to do, and I'm hoping I can count on your support to keep fighting! Next week is the primary, and I'm asking for your vote. Remember to drop off your ballot by 8 p.m. on August 2.](https://act.myngp.com/el/_4Ir6rSx0wSKK2EPcqlZDx3oCqlb7xgBzBrU_REXWmg=/zVaeKqLgyFQAa9xTnd9NWKRMZ5SLuYoXdnn7mvonL70=)**

As always, it's an honor to serve you,

Derek

body:
so this is my final plea.

Peter,

I know you're busy, but everything I'm going to say next is coming right from the heart, so I hope you'll take the time to read every word of this note.

You may not have ever heard my story, but my name is Tiffany Smiley.

**I 'm a first-time candidate, veterans advocate, and political outsider. I'm the mother of 3 amazing boys and the wife of an Army veteran.**

Like too many military families, I received a call that _shattered_ my dreams in an instant. My husband Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber while serving America in Iraq.

It was in that moment that my life changed forever.

First, through Scotty's recovery, I had to _**fight**_ to ensure his care wouldn't be compromised by inefficient government bureaucracy.

Then, I made it my life's work to _**fight**_ so every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

Now, I'm running for U.S. Senate to _**fight**_ for all Americans so they can achieve their American Dream.

This is how I've found myself in the midst of the #1 race to watch - and my primary is RAPIDLY approaching.

[**Ballots are ALREADY being returned. Every single thing we do now until Election Day will be a difference maker.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60904718:Jrax38VND:m:1:3253819041:A47188E9E03F1CAF1971E1B9BAA77B60:r)

That's why I'm reaching out.

As we're coming down to the wire, we need all hands on deck to keep up with the monstrous spending of the Democrat political machine.

We're being outraised and outspent by my career politician opponent and _I 'm starting to worry..._

There are only HOURS to turn my campaign around. We're simply running out of time.

This election will turn the tide and deliver a major defeat to the Democrats, [**I just need your help to finish the fight.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60904718:Jrax38VND:m:1:3253819041:A47188E9E03F1CAF1971E1B9BAA77B60:r)

I promise to NEVER stop my fight for you,

Tiffany Smiley

* * *
**Our country needs leadership, Friend.**
We need someone who will stand up and work to solve our nation's problems. I'm a proven leader, I've stood up to the DC bureaucrats at the VA to pave the way for ALL veterans to receive the care and treatment they deserve when they return home. Our veterans are willing to pay the ultimate price for our everyday freedoms. But when they come back home, their service is often overlooked by our very own government.
After serving our nation and laying their lives on the line overseas, our veterans should **NOT** have to beg to get the care they deserve here at home. We need to do better for those who defend our nation, Friend.
**That's why I'm running for Senate**

Dear #VALUE!,

**Mississippi has had a conservative ‘super majority’ for about a decade. But what do we have to show for it? **

To be fair, income taxes have been cut. Last year we saw a universal occupational licensing law, making it easier for people to move to our state. We also passed a law to combat Critical Race theory.

**Like many in Mississippi, I can’t help feeling that with a conservative ‘super majority’ we ought to be able to do even more.** If conservatives worked together towards shared goals, we could implement the far reaching reform that our state needs.

**The Mississippi Leadership Academy seeks to encourage the next generation of leaders in our state to work together as a team to drive meaningful change.** This six-step program will give young leaders the skills and knowledge they will need to be agents of change.

You can learn more about the Mississippi Leadership Academy [here](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=1a89f55f28&e=5703353baa). If you are interested in taking part – or know someone who is – please get in touch.

If we are to achieve change, we also need to build a mass movement in our state. The Mississippi Center for Public Policy has just been nationally recognized for doing this; we have just been shortlisted for an award.

But we would like to see Mississippi win – so please click on the graphic below and vote!

Thank you for your support!

Douglas Carswell

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3a3d05ececc345e8bda11245d3a554fe&_e=i56OF-Ofuj1J9QV1NV7xgI7shK_934ZSXOryeZla488LATjgxBET5sDgikd0d0Zmb749kIE1QVBSQktF2ai45PnIclm6W-7AOteNrscpsGb4jTph0USungAbbXmERmdHegI1jT8r4dEEzxFokjRyGqrNTpFNWEJbA_vYZXJvK6IWjI4GqvTcfkLqPMbbO-gapJs-vK2CrDEP85Z-Z6OpxqVume-J2MOVKOq1jA-OmGhh8MoImn2ssrUIrIQhG8kLCEnRfRp_vEdWHF_haqiF-n51BfFNP-FgvMryJZH9NFxvfLxf8FPfVBPXrmVSNYU7DfI_WT55u_9lY0LfK8UYCI4eqNMZlbebyOxzw5lXyxDD48_tAw76Z861IPvoZSwj-hxTGbyaG5Tdki9kBpeBZo5uNYZXJOu5543vw2eHuxfRPTG0qTeuybm7-_CCwel3 "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3a3d05ececc345e8bda11245d3a554fe&_e=i56OF-Ofuj1J9QV1NV7xgI7shK_934ZSXOryeZla488LATjgxBET5sDgikd0d0Zmb749kIE1QVBSQktF2ai45PnIclm6W-7AOteNrscpsGb4jTph0USungAbbXmERmdHegI1jT8r4dEEzxFokjRyGqrNTpFNWEJbA_vYZXJvK6IWjI4GqvTcfkLqPMbbO-gapJs-vK2CrDEP85Z-Z6OpxqVume-J2MOVKOq1jA-OmGgQ5QlAYumyCTo7JbaKPRmpfLzxoWPdgs3HVk_AttdVM--Z5O7hKXZ_XpOUJwJ5VfwvLXi4LN_bQCknS21bFioOG7vBDG5ioHiAHZUf1j3CSDgY-RIzuiekGGyrEiVzoq6Zb7Guca4Rk73IATL8Ogv1IQ4VfuvVErsc61Nq8-bhKdV_t5ph9_dbjvBVlmFSTd3zZSjPDW1qIhSx5CICx7_8 "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3a3d05ececc345e8bda11245d3a554fe&_e=i56OF-Ofuj1J9QV1NV7xgI7shK_934ZSXOryeZla488LATjgxBET5sDgikd0d0Zmb749kIE1QVBSQktF2ai45PnIclm6W-7AOteNrscpsGb4jTph0USungAbbXmERmdHegI1jT8r4dEEzxFokjRyGqrNTpFNWEJbA_vYZXJvK6IWjI4GqvTcfkLqPMbbO-gapJs-vK2CrDEP85Z-Z6OpxqVume-J2MOVKOq1jA-OmGh3xn-Rh7Rc8mRhyHhiDQiqMA7a8lxyEAEeEsqkmwk1wTTU51A7Okni-pkjou1kTu769qxWSWUKdfBXl6SX4WAeSzIvjTI4PTXBZMTv0OO1JohBaJHQcVGZT2qbmCpR97v9JEOPoIRhGoj4pD3oy3W08CHGkp24l1qakRAFjUYeyHletu7APjAIdZkONz68GlbttaSeexB4M-ZVm1SX-SJz "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

Helping pro-democracy Democrats hold their majorities in Congress is hugely important, no doubt. **But we can also make a big impact at the state level** , where we need to continue to defend voting rights and block GOP gerrymandering at every available opportunity — and that’s where the NDRC comes in.
Right now, we’re investing in 17 battleground states, with a focus on races that are critical to securing the future of democracy. That means state legislative races, state supreme court races, governor’s races, secretary of state races, and others that will play a big role in **defending the right to vote and stopping GOP gerrymandering**.
Truly, it’s hard to overstate how important some of these races are. If the GOP is allowed to completely take over the machinery of our elections while continuing to manipulate maps and surpress votes **it could eventually be lights out for our democracy** — and that’s something we just can’t sit back and let happen.
That’s why your donation to the NDRC is so important, friend. We’re working as hard as we can to defend the right to vote and help elect Democracy Defenders across the country, but we need your help to keep it up. So if you can, please pitch in today to help fuel our fight:

In several states where litigation is pending – including North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, and others – it's possible that some new maps will need to be drawn before the 2024 elections. So to get ready, we're investing in new technologies, data, and mapping innovations.

[PITCH IN TO SUPPORT OUR WORK](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48556205/358672063/-982003667?amount=20&refcode=20220729.1rb_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYxNjY2ZDFlLTI5MTAtZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4MmMwZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d4SKd2FlL_MYLHTKxNi3OfMRqZliLEdeYzD5V54Ko80=)

All over the country, the GOP is investing in state and local races, including important state court elections. That means we need to prepare for the long term by electing pro-democracy leaders.

The good news is our work in 2018 and 2020 made a big difference for Democrats running for state-level offices. And in 2022, we're targeting races in 17 states that will have a big impact on the future of redistricting.

# Senate GOP stabs veterans in the heart, lungs and back
---
| Veterans groups fumed at the Capitol yesterday when the long-anticipated passage of a comprehensive bill to address toxic exposure in the military failed to get the 60 votes necessary to overcome the filibuster, effectively killing legislation decades in the making.

The bill’s demise came as a shock to many as activists were at the Capitol planning to _celebrate_ the passage of the bill sometime this week.

Advocates for reform on toxic exposure have been working for years to even get what was seen as a “compromise” health package that would help the VA meet the needs of the more than 200,000 veterans who were already waiting on the Airborne Toxins and Burn Pits Registry two years ago.

Since then, the list has grown substantially, nearing 300,000 today, and many of those who were on that list two years ago have already died.

The funding would have given the VA money to hire more doctors, more specialists, open new clinics and treatment centers, new hospitals, include more experimental and developing treatments, cover a wider range of ailments, and significantly improve the quality of care the VA provides.

The passage of this bill would have represented a major milestone in how veterans access care for service-acquired diseases, which have plagued military personnel for as long as war has existed.

>From the Wounded Warriors Project:
“It’s not just burn pits causing these illnesses and injuries – some who have fallen ill have reported being exposed to chemicals found in fire-fighting fluids, depleted uranium shells, engine fumes, and more. For those seeking treatment for these illnesses and toxic exposure sustained during their military service, the largest barrier for utilizing VA health systems is establishing a service-connected disability.”

We would expect the VA to care for veterans who had been shot in combat, or were injured by an IED, or suffered amputations or any other physical ailment as a result of serving our country.

But we don’t properly treat a range of health issues resulting from service that aren’t as visible, including airborne toxins, carcinogenic fumes, PTSD, anxiety/depression, and TBIs.

Agent Orange – one of many carcinogenic herbicides we sprayed over Vietnam – has killed or maimed more than 400,000 US veterans _that we know of. _One of those veterans was my father-in-law, who served in Vietnam when he was 19, and died 40 years later within months of his diagnosis.

The United States government settled with about 50,000 of those fully-disabled vets or their surviving spouses between 1984-1997, paying a whopping $3,800 each. Total. Sum.

The _monthly _benefit for losing a limb in combat is more than that.

Our nation has not fulfilled its promises to our Veterans, and while measures have been taken to slowly address health issues caused by a war from 50 years, those exposed to toxic substances post-9/11 are still waiting for help.

Disabled American Veterans emphasizes just how important this package for veterans would be:

“The Comprehensive and Overdue Support for Troops (COST) of War Act of 2021 is sweeping legislation that would provide generations of veterans suffering from several sources of toxic exposures—not just burn pits— with benefits and VA healthcare. The bill would rightly recognize the federal government’s role and responsibility to provide health care and disability compensation to veterans suffering the impacts of their toxic exposure. Additionally, the bill would establish processes to establish new presumptive conditions for exposed veterans.

The Honoring our Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics (PACT) Act of 2021 (H.R. 3967) is comprehensive legislation that would similarly provide healthcare for millions of veterans exposed to airborne hazards and burn puts. However, it would also establish presumption of service connection for 23 ailments, including respiratory diseases and cancers, related to burn pits. The bill would also create a presumption of exposure to radiation.”

The PACT Act was named after Heath Robinson, a sergeant with the Ohio National Guard who was deployed to Kosovo and Iraq. He died in 2020 from lung cancer attributed to burn pit exposure.

Open-air burn pits were common at U.S. military bases during the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan. Dangerous materials, from electronics and vehicles to human waste, were regularly doused in jet fuel and set ablaze, spewing toxic fumes and carcinogens into the air.

Many others have developed cancers, respiratory illnesses and other serious conditions as a direct result of exposure to toxins, veteran groups say.

President Joe Biden, who has championed the PACT Act, said he believes his late son Beau Biden’s brain cancer was linked to exposure to burn pits while he was deployed in Iraq in 2008.

But the Senate – who voted 84-12 on an almost identical version of the PACT Act less than a month ago – suddenly and without explanation flipped and killed the legislation in what was supposed to be the reconciliation of bills _already passed by the House and Senate._

Only _eight_ Republicans carried their yay vote over from last month’s roll call. And because doing the right thing is applauded as an act of courage these days, here's the list of people who DID THE RIGHT THING:
Every single Democrat in the Senate, plus
Boozman (R-AR)
Capito (R-WV)
Collins (R-ME)
Graham (R-SC)
Grassley (R-IA)

Here are the 41 Republicans who voted NO on treating veterans for service-acquired diseases:
Barrasso (R-WY)

Scott (R-SC)

Thune (R-SD)

Tuberville (R-AL)
Wicker (R-MS)
Young (R-IN)

As the congressional district the highest number of veterans per capita, who has seen first-hand what this kind of exposure can do to soldiers _and _the massive VA failure in accepting responsibility in the past, I want to know _why_ Senate Republicans killed a bipartisan effort to staff our clinics, provide emerging technology that will allow us to detect diseases and save lives, and to force hundreds of thousands of veterans to keep waiting for care that may not come before they die.

The partisan toxicity and hatred on issues that should be simple, easy, and universally supported ferments disgust toward Congress and its failures to do what it was meant to do – serve the people.

We need leaders who don’t care who proposes the legislation, or which party backs it, or whose name is on it – if it needs to be done, get it done and get out of the way. Keep moving through the list of issues that are piling up that we can’t resolve because Washington runs on a points system with two camps always trying to outscore the other.

Stop playing for teams and start working for us.

And as for Florida Senator Rick Scott, who led the effort in the Senate to flip the vote and kill the PACT Act.... We’ll see you in two years, buddy.

Team,
Exciting news – our second ad of the campaign is officially live and is on televisions in Michigan’s new 7th district. Check it out:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220730 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20220730]
This ad highlights one of Elissa’s priorities in Congress: working with anyone, Republican or Democrat, that’s serious about lowering the cost of prescription drugs. There was no one better to help us highlight that message than Dr. George Smith, a family medicine physician based in Lansing.
Because of Elissa’s Real Time Benefits Act, a bipartisan bill that President Trump signed into law, Dr. Smith’s patients will soon be able to comparison-shop and see the pharmacy with the lowest price for their prescriptions before they even leave his office. It’s no-brainer legislation such as this, and things like capping monthly insulin costs at $35, capping annual out-of-pocket drug costs for seniors at $2000, as well as allowing Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices that fuels so much of Elissa’s work.
On the other hand, her opponent has been much more friendly to the pharmaceutical industry during his time in the state legislature. He voted to continue allowing pharmaceutical companies to escape accountability when their drugs hurt or kill people, upholding a Michigan law—the only one in the country—that shields them from nearly all liability. One of his top donors, a major backer of the immunity law, donated $40,000 to him directly and spent more than $250,000 supporting his campaigns.
Thanks for checking out the ad, and if you liked it – consider chipping in a few bucks. Contributions from our grassroots supporters are a big part of the reason we’re able to film these!

subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8c2v93k82b3a8k78pdsrob75cnkd7q0jmbbhmbg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56egn4tblm1on4t1kmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfdc71e2on1ob1cph31crj61jbdctm6uqj4tpmcho76cpgsgrm7djjmuom5clhm3jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8omct776dh6fdj2coo71cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdim9oj0c5g64pj24no)
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgg6e9fe1uu26qivrhmc1q5i0iqme8tjocb5r2i0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g62o32cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm04j8vt4rd4fd9ei5u1fhpd7u7nrnelikc5vgj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g62o32cph2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znkhlk14r2s7oi9m3ph7658a89l3m62p64jlvac0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g62o32cph2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Dear
Friend,

While
many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew
the giant, they likely don't know his full story-especially the
tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to
repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about
fathers and sons.

King
David's momentous story provides profound insights into many of
life's most important questions, including: What are my
responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I
lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way
to lead others?

Taught by
Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, "The David
Story: Shepherd, Father, King" examines the Old Testament books
of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores
David's character and the consequences of his choices on his
family and the people of Israel.

This is
why we've produced our online course, "The David Story: Shepherd,
Father, King," which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve
your copy using this secure link:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd

By
viewing the course, you'll learn more about the nature of God,
family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you'll learn
more about what truly matters in life.

I hope
you'll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with
your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or
homeschool curriculum.

Let's
learn what truly matters in life by studying "The David Story."

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

you'd like to secure a DVD box set of "The David Story" while
they're available, you can have one shipped directly to your home
for any gift of $100 or more in support of reaching and teaching
millions on behalf of liberty.

Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z77t3vjdjlmvg9skiuh1deqvuv2s5lgiuf9psum8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziclg0de0fn5frgacon24to2gsna66qb5plrgun0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh4fqlsfkt3cj67cgnm2l44pmvhqrn79i56eth78_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate – they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know – like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfs6tavhoch0klammasudgjfh39bb6ahvj6n78qg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq16s7441gar1m9cn6movv3vsg0ockopr64p9fbg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs) As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming – and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znamp09mbg1vln42tt54u06ac9ko79asj8hqu8d0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkp5sf8ih610khc9hkjj8asenvvfc683k8i7ll38_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs) You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something – this will be the most important race in the entire country – but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgopem47c4dooq47l7kdqjvct9lnt056perjvpc0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z08143v5otf3sgbhgdaod5rmo67kpq30t0ftt1g0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs) Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1ap7tp2enke5r9flmpq14k5lkgnqf82u1f8oibg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more – will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvid9ijv07iai4jsja1ojva6p3kf4e1tuu0dp5m8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjpdhh4v7fl3k0coj7jmhk86qa7rnj68q9vv7h0g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4s9g6ao74cth2bs)

Each decision broke along partisan lines, with the six Republican-appointed justices voting in lockstep. If any doubt remained, these rulings confirmed that our nation’s highest court has become a partisan body. But the disturbing truth is: **this is just the beginning.** **We need trained lawyers in Congress ready and equipped to take action to unwind these recent destructive rulings – and to protect our legal system against future conservative attacks.** I am a human rights lawyer by training. I have the skills to protect Americans’ fundamental civil rights in Congress. But first, I have to get there. **[Will you chip in $5, $10 or $15 to make sure I can work to uphold Constitutional rights in Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48535745/358633836/1973301878?source=MG_EM_FR_WL_220311_3_5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNTgxYWRhMC0xNjEwLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UZs8L_vRYettd7ZwlSPdnbVQjZuVhzLKIGDVXPDM5sM=)** **After graduating from Vermont Law School** , where I focused on human rights and civil liberties, I clerked for the late Judge Peter Hall on the Second Circuit Court of Appeals. I reviewed federal appeals, drafted opinions, and saw firsthand how federal cases are won and lost in the details. Before serving as Vermont’s Lieutenant Governor, **I served statewide as an Assistant Attorney General** in the criminal division, working to ensure access to justice for all Vermonters. I know trust in government depends on our ability to uphold and protect the Constitution. **This is a make-or-break moment in history.** I’ve spent my career working to promote and protect fundamental rights; in Congress, I’ll bring the full force of my legal training to bear. Friend,

There are three things one can give you in a campaign: their time, their money, and their vote. Throughout this campaign, I have been incredibly honored to receive the support of so many people across Florida’s new 23rd Congressional District.

At a time when the community is under threat and facing a wave of abhorrent attacks, I have been honored and humbled by the support of the **_Palm Beach County Human Rights Council Voters Alliance_**. As Florida’s oldest organization fighting for equal rights for the LGBTQ+ community, they have been on the frontline fighting for equality in housing, public accommodation, county employment, and more.

As we face a post-Roe world, the work of national organizations like **_Her Bold Move_** to elevate pro-choice women leaders is absolutely essential and I am honored to have their support. They know I will continue to stand up to extremists and support reproductive freedom as I have throughout my life.

And amid the senseless gun violence plaguing our communities that requires real action like banning assault weapons and high-capacity magazines, it’s an honor to earn the **_Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate Distinction_**.

**[Friend, these important organizations have committed their support. Now, I’m counting on you to join them in supporting our campaign. clean_body: Friend, There are three things one can give you in a campaign: their time, their money, and their vote. Throughout this campaign, I have been incredibly honored to receive the support of so many people across Florida’s new 23rd Congressional District. At a time when the community is under threat and facing a wave of abhorrent attacks, I have been honored and humbled by the support of the Palm Beach County Human Rights Council Voters Alliance. As Florida’s oldest organization fighting for equal rights for the LGBTQ+ community, they have been on the frontline fighting for equality in housing, public accommodation, county employment, and more. As we face a post-Roe world, the work of national organizations like Her Bold Move to elevate pro-choice women leaders is absolutely essential and I am honored to have their support. They know I will continue to stand up to extremists and support reproductive freedom as I have throughout my life. And amid the senseless gun violence plaguing our communities that requires real action like banning assault weapons and high-capacity magazines, it’s an honor to earn the Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate Distinction. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = = = = = = There are only a few weeks left until the primary and every dollar you can give will make a real difference in this election. Just this week the New York Times put out an article with this eyebrow-raising headline: | | | Peter, just this week the _New York Times_ put out an article with this eyebrow-raising headline: [](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUbw7cC4M284fOohl8L0qEE0nkzKQ11YG509hBS2hYypEje_Y6k6TIV7guSAvLLhqK_NipXMrnQLfYQlenvW-Pj4zJpo5J_DP_9sbZTDPvHCp2caUn9AoWxC3Ld7kzXArRHC-OF_LmQJ5kYc9eOMywbxf4fAP8yFiAe7Nhv87HXGOlV9NFptMZiIcknx1zXij8656eOs4Q7pBuHt5DvIv7GxmIGfokOlDnRxSpLxywQBs686NsdvpfL9RW5wck9-3ueniz2ffsdaLzMR6IsLz_TCGlC7TzY_X6HQRmnRDiyP0oARLQpodJxolr2LXwufOHh1s2Tn6m0uxTHaPeDfS8Lw/3o6/dgvkBMw_SfOoeY80ltXiOw/h0/Bi0I8eeWsLdWqz6pmu6CRP7x5frEoOHVdS3Xlu9yg8g) In short, they explain that the DCCC has spent hundreds of thousands of dollars in a Republican Congressional primary to prop up a more extreme, Trump-aligned candidate in hopes that he’ll win the primary and be easier for Democrats to defeat. And where did a lot of that money come from? Grassroots donations made by folks like you. **That’s right: the DCCC is playing political roulette with their supporters’ money in the hopes of electing corporate Democrats, rather than moving towards progress.** Here at the Working Families Party, we don’t gamble with your generous donations, and we certainly don’t spend them on boosting insurrectionist Republicans. We use your contributions to help elect candidates who will fight for all of us — which makes reaching our online fundraising goal this month that much more important. **_[We only have one day left, and about $15,000 still to go to hit our July goal. And where did a lot of that money come from? Grassroots donations made by folks like you. That’s right: the DCCC is playing political roulette with their supporters’ money in the hopes of electing corporate Democrats, rather than moving towards progress. Here at the Working Families Party, we don’t gamble with your generous donations, and we certainly don’t spend them on boosting insurrectionist Republicans. We use your contributions to help elect candidates who will fight for all of us — which makes reaching our online fundraising goal this month that much more important. When you contribute to our party, you’re not covering the bill for us to play political games. You’re supporting our get-out-the-vote efforts and deep organizing work, with strategies centered around the people who actually live in the communities where our WFP champions are running. We do everything from training volunteers, to phone banking and texting, or even covering the printing costs for literature to pass out to voters. All of these resources add up to big wins for our WFP slate, but they all cost money. When we reach out to you about our big end of month goals, the money you chip in is what helps cover these expenses — and it has a direct impact on elections. In August alone, we have a huge wave of primaries to get through in states like Wisconsin, Missouri, Michigan, Connecticut, and New York. Reaching this goal will set the tone for everything we’re able to accomplish over the next few weeks and impact which candidates we’re able to help across the finish line in November. body:
Still! And forever...
| | | |
---
---
|
# Democrats are forever tied to "Defund the Police"
---
|
---
---
| | |
---|---
|
In the summer of 2020, cities across the nation were in turmoil.
Rioters posing as protesters occupied large sections of cities. They destroyed property in cities from Seattle to Washington D.C. and kept business owners from their places of business.
The riots happened nationwide following the killing of George Floyd by Minneapolis police in May of that year. Among many consequences, one of the worst was that many Democrat-controlled city governments cowed to this lawlessness by committing to "Defund the Police." There was no clear definition of what actions that phrase entailed, but in some cases, it meant entirely eliminating some police departments.
| | |
---|---
|
These efforts were based entirely on emotional pleas, but that did not stop Vice-President Kamala Harris and Democratic members of Congress from echoing them. While the Vice-President did not fully support the effort, the coded language she used came very close. "[We do have to reimagine what public safety looks like. And here's the thing. It is status quo thinking to believe that putting more police on the streets creates more safety. That's wrong. It's just wrong](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dnDAkXiYdg66rGjdUKZJmC9RT45VYyM9_cPP9sKJa8HPNhM96-YrX5qiyL8L1C76l0hcvUYg19oMuGqNUqEPUiAt-4LRiZIN4bCEaNpxQhmZFo5Y2dr8KJx3U6pkwzBuWZgurdV4tOsszZsSIq1wVifwPEkkdoN3phQE5fKxptfwD09N45Rei62uVWrJlS8Rp9MIXByHLJc=&c=0DTKeEuamH3-NOW9gkiOLt8oz3YXvkYv_jnJa1NTFFNIh5NNHbbIoA==&ch=JFy4BbgKusrtUBUEXaP07sQxg3XSrI-P4KN35hEVsD20rRrX_BoSKg==)," Harris said.
Now many of the politicians--all of them Democrats--who supported some form of defunding are having to [backtrack on their wildly wrong-headed, radical positions](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dnDAkXiYdg66rGjdUKZJmC9RT45VYyM9_cPP9sKJa8HPNhM96-YrX5qiyL8L1C76nNzYyeC2fqV440EF_b0S2IPZqdlYmmzKD5Mg8qS5y4R0Z5AjK7HAZpeIxakWufIFnuh67SS11svzvbmUWPGtRz03STiVGnsKKHYLFZ0wmFeUrgy3UYIAINByUGeC-obwQinQRs4x64JI8jVyMgSjNsqOjIv1hhTKBrp_QqweURs=&c=0DTKeEuamH3-NOW9gkiOLt8oz3YXvkYv_jnJa1NTFFNIh5NNHbbIoA==&ch=JFy4BbgKusrtUBUEXaP07sQxg3XSrI-P4KN35hEVsD20rRrX_BoSKg==). This is largely because they are currently running for office and must run away from a position that voters nationwide do not want. What played well in 2020 is no longer in vogue in 2022.
Meanwhile, some members of Congress who want to defund the police in communities like yours [are actually using campaign funds](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dnDAkXiYdg66rGjdUKZJmC9RT45VYyM9_cPP9sKJa8HPNhM96-YrX5qiyL8L1C76PJfO894Ipl3N7bk_KEJ5_ZjlgVBCOkm5uNVhjvWRMuxNAFaGk6upt_hDAZ8DHAB22NGkwFYfolzER7WvjwKehSO1yvvf1Q1uKgmOTwcsVMNPwqPd43ZW1SLQeOYlbALPxkZhm_nC5-xiEThBT-lExmSTDtDc1fQ11e-9LHNJ434s-hOk7BDa-nwy6JCwRtVvj9dqymBuHZwUcY_lWDPAtQ==&c=0DTKeEuamH3-NOW9gkiOLt8oz3YXvkYv_jnJa1NTFFNIh5NNHbbIoA==&ch=JFy4BbgKusrtUBUEXaP07sQxg3XSrI-P4KN35hEVsD20rRrX_BoSKg==) to provide for their own physical security. When these politicians' own lives are at stake, people with badges and guns are important, but not for you.
Still, these frustrating events are beside the bigger (and more unfortunate) point that in places such as [Minneapolis and New York, crimes of all sorts](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dnDAkXiYdg66rGjdUKZJmC9RT45VYyM9_cPP9sKJa8HPNhM96-YrX5qiyL8L1C76nNzYyeC2fqV440EF_b0S2IPZqdlYmmzKD5Mg8qS5y4R0Z5AjK7HAZpeIxakWufIFnuh67SS11svzvbmUWPGtRz03STiVGnsKKHYLFZ0wmFeUrgy3UYIAINByUGeC-obwQinQRs4x64JI8jVyMgSjNsqOjIv1hhTKBrp_QqweURs=&c=0DTKeEuamH3-NOW9gkiOLt8oz3YXvkYv_jnJa1NTFFNIh5NNHbbIoA==&ch=JFy4BbgKusrtUBUEXaP07sQxg3XSrI-P4KN35hEVsD20rRrX_BoSKg==) have spiked and continue to rise. Major cities and some states such as New York have implemented no-cash bail, instantly sending criminals back to the street after arrest.
| | |
---|---
|
What's worse is that defunding police efforts do not stop at cities. Some would-be members of Congress call for defunding [not only local police](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dnDAkXiYdg66rGjdUKZJmC9RT45VYyM9_cPP9sKJa8HPNhM96-YrX5qiyL8L1C76d-iIAZ2TnXv4b_GBzX8FV85dNuU7onQVheuVoYkrKQ0gAb-WWwNn3C8_24C5RHKDOS4y1ElRN3Fl_dkeaImk2eTsPM9KiXoifx8-kfUyrIRodL2X0CkCQQvPQRRhxOts4SMnWNayMgbt8O_dYxlPP5-RKNNs20oG6JwlRfxJDuEwehl5P3q7rTglpuF14Krl5F2-uA88OTM3QU7MNKGGMEQYqgacKfhY&c=0DTKeEuamH3-NOW9gkiOLt8oz3YXvkYv_jnJa1NTFFNIh5NNHbbIoA==&ch=JFy4BbgKusrtUBUEXaP07sQxg3XSrI-P4KN35hEVsD20rRrX_BoSKg==) but also federal law enforcement agencies such as U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement's (ICE).
The nation cannot allow itself to forget what the Democrats have done and are doing to the country through their defunding efforts. Police are quitting and retiring in record numbers. Crime, including violent crime, continues to soar. While there is some walking back of these policies, much damage has already been done.

At least one radical progressive think tank has tried to "reimagine" what Defund the Police means. Like the politicians they support, they are trying to make the stigma of Defund go away. They claim the movement is misunderstood, and that Defund does not mean "[abolish](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001dnDAkXiYdg66rGjdUKZJmC9RT45VYyM9_cPP9sKJa8HPNhM96-YrX5qiyL8L1C76BTWYpP_w393BxDwol1vsxw9UKm1xVsRgWr7wYC_ha5BTyn9jkBA6e_26AY6efuekOq57Bs7Zix7GnvNxxmAp-BRofeyX1ENgJo36o5I1-eAp89hKgOxlaQewS2XL0ySZGGU43Ksz065mlUHbO1Y-jROKrGMdz9hNJQ-saI9hGWywFKXOkb2-Ug9qn_4crsn8BYcPd5p3XwU=&c=0DTKeEuamH3-NOW9gkiOLt8oz3YXvkYv_jnJa1NTFFNIh5NNHbbIoA==&ch=JFy4BbgKusrtUBUEXaP07sQxg3XSrI-P4KN35hEVsD20rRrX_BoSKg==)."
| | |
---|---
|
However, we cannot be fooled. We all saw the dozens of cities ablaze in 2020. We understand what Defund meant and means even today. The radicals cannot escape the fact that they held Defund as a policy goal. Defund legislation is intended to tear down our government. Should any of these schemes ever succeed, our cities will quickly devolve into chaos. We are catching a glimpse of this with the partial defunding measures already put into effect.

Coloradans cannot afford to let these radicals accomplish their goals. Brittany Pettersen and her partners Nancy Pelosi, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and Adam Schiff have made clear what they want. They know that for now they cannot say "Defund the Police." But a win for them in 2022 means you will see the consequences of their agenda.
| |
---|---
|
Our answer is to return to our adherence to law. We can restore sanity to this situation by standing for our law enforcement professionals and the needs of our communities. While many of these issues are not at the federal level, our congressional leaders must advocate for law and order--and prevent these dangerous ideas from encroaching upon federal law.

Together, we can stop Brittany Pettersen and her radical cohorts from destroying our beautiful Colorado cities.

## About Erik

**We're reaching out to ask for something a little different than usual — but first, some good news:**
Right now, we're on pace to reach our online grassroots contribution goal ahead of tomorrow's end-of-month fundraising deadline.
That's huge, because unlike our opponent, we're funding this campaign through people-power alone — not corporate PACs.
**Now, some bad news:**
While we're on pace to reach our online contributions goal, the _average amount donated_ from each of those contributions has plummeted recently. Almost $11 less than this time last month.
That's also huge...but not in the same way.
The way we see it, we have two options to get back on track. Either we pick up the pace with a lot more contributions from a lot more people before midnight tomorrow, or we ask our supporters to chip in just a _bit_ more than we usually do.
Typically when we ask people to make their first online contribution, we ask for $3 — but if you're able to take a big step and pitch in $10, it would go a long way toward our campaign's success in next month's primary. What do you say?

Cheri Beasley gives me hope.
#

Hey there, it's Cory.
I know times can feel heavy right now, but there’s promise on the horizon — if we come together to fight for it.
When I think about all that Senate Republicans have blocked us from doing, I remind myself to focus on the light ahead. Cheri Beasley is someone who gives me that hope, so [**I’m reaching out today to ask you to support her campaign before Sunday’s deadline.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-july22.kbaN_T&refcode=em220730-2-ma&t=1&akid=1350%2E357359%2EbiIGb3)
She’s running one of the best campaigns we’ve ever seen in North Carolina. Despite National Republicans blasting her with despicable and false attack ads, she’s stood strong, fought back and kept the race neck and neck.
As a former public defender, judge and the first Black woman to serve as Chief Justice of North Carolina, she would bring a perspective and experience wholly unique to the U.S. Senate — all the while making history as the Tar Heel state’s first Black senator.
Like me, she believes that not only is a future possible where each of us has the opportunity to thrive, but that it is what our children deserve. She will be a relentless fighter for justice and ensure we live up to the promise of America.
But if we are going to flip my dad’s home state of North Carolina, then she needs all of us to get involved. That's why I am urgently asking you to support my friend Cheri Beasley’s campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina before her July deadline:

While the cost of almost everything continues to skyrocket, politicians like Brian Fitzpatrick are ignoring the needs of everyday Pennsylvanians. Corporations are taking advantage of the crises we’re facing by raising prices for gas, groceries, and even baby formula. Because of their greed, working families in PA are paying higher prices for lower-quality products and services. So when I saw my opponent, Brian Fitzpatrick, vote against critical policies that would help support Pennsylvanians, like the Infant Formula Supplemental Appropriations Act and the Consumer Fuel Price Gouging Prevention Act , I was outraged. Too many politicians in D.C. have no idea what it’s like to live paycheck to paycheck to make ends meet. Growing up, I watched as my family struggled to pay for basic necessities like healthcare, housing, childcare, and education. name: Mandela Barnes
subject: I need your help to defeat Ron Johnson
body:
Derek,
I'm reaching out to respectfully ask if you can split a $25 contribution between my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and CommonGood. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220730_CGVA_Barnes]
Here's why:
Wisconsin's Senate seat is one of the most likely to flip in 2022. And I'm relying on an unprecedented grassroots movement in order to defeat Ron Johnson.
I simply cannot do this alone.
At the very start of this campaign, I made the big decision to reject all corporate PAC money. It was a risk I was willing to take because I trusted that people like you would come together in large numbers to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat.
This race is too important for us to come up short. So I am asking you directly:
Can I count on you to split a $25 contribution between my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin and CommonGood? It would mean a lot if you could chip in today. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220730_CGVA_Barnes]
[http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_rw?refcode=20220729_CGVA_Warnock]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220730_CGVA_Barnes&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220730_CGVA_Barnes&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220730_CGVA_Barnes&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220730_CGVA_Barnes&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220730_CGVA_Barnes&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220730_CGVA_Barnes]
I've been traveling all across the state of Wisconsin, hearing directly from people who are understandably frustrated with candidates like Ron Johnson who got elected only to serve himself.
Since he's been in office, Ron Johnson has doubled his wealth as a result of the tax breaks that the Republican Party passed under Trump. And he even went so far as to complain that his wealth has only doubled – not quadrupled – during his time in Washington.
But that's not all. News recently broke that Ron Johnson tried to rig the election for Donald Trump by giving a slate of fake electors to Mike Pence on January 6th.
Then he celebrated Roe being overturned.
Enough is enough.
I am running for U.S. Senate to fight for middle class families, and to deliver opportunity for everyone. I’ll vote to abolish the filibuster and defend abortion rights, address the climate crisis, and rebuild the middle class.
But in order for that to happen, my campaign needs to stay on top of meeting our fundraising goals.
Because the truth is that we won't have the resources we need to win this race if we don't reach our fundraising goals ahead of the Wisconsin Senate primary.
As of this morning, we're just a bit short of where we need to be before midnight tonight.
Can you add your contribution today?
Please split a $25 contribution to my campaign and CommonGood before midnight tonight. We'll put your donation immediately to work to defeat Ron Johnson. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20220730_CGVA_Barnes]
Thank you in advance for contributing today. These final days before the primary are a big moment for our campaign, and it means a lot to know I can count on your support when it matters most.
All my best,
Mandela Barnes

subject: I am 100% invested.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN BASS FOR MAYOR 2022 – GENERAL
body:
But I need to know if you are, too.
Team,

I’m reaching out to you today because you’ve shown your support for my campaign in the past. My team appreciates your willingness to be a part of our mission.

Let me remind you why I’m running for mayor.

Our city is experiencing several crises. The public health, public safety, and economic crisis of homelessness has evolved into a full-blown humanitarian emergency. 40,000 people sleep on the streets of L.A. every night – more than in any other city in the nation.

I’m running because I know that tackling homelessness means developing a comprehensive approach that addresses the immediate crisis along with the root causes: lack of affordable housing, health care, access to job opportunities, and residential alcohol and drug treatment.

I’m confident Los Angeles can be a city where everyone can access quality health care. Los Angeles can be a city where its economy — one of the world's most robust, intricate, and complex economies — can work for everyone. Los Angeles can be a city where everyone can afford housing, where everyone can earn livable wages, and where services and resources are provided to help get folks who may have stumbled back on their feet.

As a daughter of this city, I am 100% invested in its success. I have the experience, and I have the determination to make real, lasting change. With your help, we can make this dream a reality.

With our end-of-month deadline tomorrow, I'm asking for your support so we can reach our $25,000 July fundraising goal.

clean_body: But I need to know if you are, too. Team, I’m reaching out to you today because you’ve shown your support for my campaign in the past. My team appreciates your willingness to be a part of our mission. Let me remind you why I’m running for mayor. Our city is experiencing several crises. The public health, public safety, and economic crisis of homelessness has evolved into a full-blown humanitarian emergency. 40,000 people sleep on the streets of L.A. every night – more than in any other city in the nation. I’m running because I know that tackling homelessness means developing a comprehensive approach that addresses the immediate crisis along with the root causes: lack of affordable housing, health care, access to job opportunities, and residential alcohol and drug treatment. I’m confident Los Angeles can be a city where everyone can access quality health care. Los Angeles can be a city where its economy — one of the world's most robust, intricate, and complex economies — can work for everyone. Los Angeles can be a city where everyone can afford housing, where everyone can earn livable wages, and where services and resources are provided to help get folks who may have stumbled back on their feet. As a daughter of this city, I am 100% invested in its success. I have the experience, and I have the determination to make real, lasting change. With your help, we can make this dream a reality. With our end-of-month deadline tomorrow, I'm asking for your support so we can reach our $25,000 July fundraising goal.
