Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05cb59de6ac149dd932b79b60462aa0b&_e=-cjFUYADFXTTk7R8iHRlit_Ek-ebP72ySsYUpHOvTaySUH3yKTOaj4MtgVcQz7RyFowdvk2vmb_NwL9E8sjppAW-zTRWytsPol95hRQ6UUSJEB-e6idKLM3l4D-IgkbqIfM5AZXe02bSyZAx--8htK-haqQkOQqbsL2L0GS5pIe6X4oo3Nzp5MwxfbD7OkZQxSuI7DB8boM1mSr-SILAdNIPqE4axIWd6MkoqpthvVWHAfAmh_yIuN4r4dlA2Q-DKiN775VIqBqpuiNjIXWePTV0_QmslRToSIMzamwH59eAkZYWktNZjE6tGM9-MZIH09xLTpmpekJp7U7P8JoqVum_eDrZ1IBn8kcs2bcun7UxU7PogmKs0MCzMusZpxgTmAjd9fl9cyqoKpd5jXpMX50cEHmkNTNrR_OwIBmmtr5rJRv4b2pxWQfFs-8HTZxM_UMcC5hRxiWI8vGlHyrWeYnKn7U3j3neW969s9XyCwA%3D) [DONATE NOW](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05cb59de6ac149dd932b79b60462aa0b&_e=-cjFUYADFXTTk7R8iHRlit_Ek-ebP72ySsYUpHOvTaySUH3yKTOaj4MtgVcQz7RyFowdvk2vmb_NwL9E8sjppAW-zTRWytsPol95hRQ6UUSJEB-e6idKLM3l4D-IgkbqIfM5AZXe02bSyZAx--8htK-haqQkOQqbsL2L0GS5pIe6X4oo3Nzp5MwxfbD7OkZQxSuI7DB8boM1mSr-SILAdNIPqE4axIWd6MkoqpthvVWHAfAmh_yIuN4r4dlA2Q-DPuTjLYct3PD3QB5EMLZs0YbHYDSodR-DPpfGURirWCz57NXBEitBP5JUONYLaPUlwy9nLxUqDmP95dC6tTmgGLJSZxGUNnzAx9CKKbVZD1C2K4fCNH0QsIRUiMZhQJK82FcZc4ULI8D9vf8aUs1agxeBHdBuhimm6CWzj-UIwWZd5hs2L1Y28aexSDh7-rJH_S7o5-1Kl9fHEvnkORa74_NmTNZD9-bJH5tLLx0M1IM%3D)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05cb59de6ac149dd932b79b60462aa0b&_e=-cjFUYADFXTTk7R8iHRlit_Ek-ebP72ySsYUpHOvTaySUH3yKTOaj4MtgVcQz7RyFowdvk2vmb_NwL9E8sjppAW-zTRWytsPol95hRQ6UUSJEB-e6idKLM3l4D-IgkbqIfM5AZXe02bSyZAx--8htK-haqQkOQqbsL2L0GS5pIe6X4oo3Nzp5MwxfbD7OkZQxSuI7DB8boM1mSr-SILAdNIPqE4axIWd6MkoqpthvVWHAfAmh_yIuN4r4dlA2Q-DxWbrTsvrJ2roXgoQNIi0WhAasQU_hWM0o3R7egfjbnv0dkBkubM-fckujZFYLbCaN4ev4RSlqCW_hJZQlJZZoDzFK6ohd0SYp3X3khmpFDw_rgXkPer-Bp1-bFumLFRlSssnLrvOudGmr5lZN645aaBEteEDGFR_xNCyr4_0kzq-nph6LalBMhAzn7LwKXmSN8vPTkFOJbV4N2dWUeSaOqGzxfkmx9pz8u7VYo97-bc%3D)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate – they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know – like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05cb59de6ac149dd932b79b60462aa0b&_e=-cjFUYADFXTTk7R8iHRlit_Ek-ebP72ySsYUpHOvTaySUH3yKTOaj4MtgVcQz7RyFowdvk2vmb_NwL9E8sjppAW-zTRWytsPol95hRQ6UUSJEB-e6idKLM3l4D-IgkbqIfM5AZXe02bSyZAx--8htK-haqQkOQqbsL2L0GS5pIe6X4oo3Nzp5MwxfbD7OkZQxSuI7DB8boM1mSr-SILAdNIPqE4axIWd6MkoqpthvVWHAfAmh_yIuN4r4dlA2Q-DlybI_Vc2V2rrVtQNZtNenUYjf8-m577ZMwqh_-SKuY6miLqMTj2ODJqVlkswbAq3KmF1sjejXS8SAQoyRTbatvjS8agvb26idB1B9-jNEKsL_8uKqJU2cYtyvIdAWTGFiM-bDeIAf3G1vE6kk3BuiEYwMMuupnbgjHo4WjM5RYeLoZrX2ucQasq0-zgHSI3EwrxHBIqHIenSwj9MRMJUwzkNzNovcy4ve8gazeIIzy0%3D) [DONATE NOW](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=05cb59de6ac149dd932b79b60462aa0b&_e=-cjFUYADFXTTk7R8iHRlit_Ek-ebP72ySsYUpHOvTaySUH3yKTOaj4MtgVcQz7RyFowdvk2vmb_NwL9E8sjppAW-zTRWytsPol95hRQ6UUSJEB-e6idKLM3l4D-IgkbqIfM5AZXe02bSyZAx--8htK-haqQkOQqbsL2L0GS5pIe6X4oo3Nzp5MwxfbD7OkZQxSuI7DB8boM1mSr-SILAdNIPqE4axIWd6MkoqpthvVWHAfAmh_yIuN4r4dlA2Q-DTGADVAfCV0jnvjPA12zI49uvFNI0pBktzxRe3b_KQ0cwssIxWrvSwsG4ILBl531NqqBt6b-wah6WqBxBRqu-EEoVXKN-gXLXiP9ogVhf3JkQqUpvYmbozCm1HNiy_kt4mbza_7WuNfchiip1kiA24-lgfOiDxasuNZroUmv-jDBMwCUvu25u6-PwyTztwNhAaHy_HjOZHZOvomLfyXVGFniExvM6m55MoSNN_Q_4q5w%3D) As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming – and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something – this will be the most important race in the entire country – but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

“ _I know our country is on a cliff - with record inflation, the highest in the nation right here in Tampa Bay, we are struggling with the cost of food and fuel. We also face a Southern Border crisis that no one in the Biden White House will even visit. We need real leadership in Washington, to be a partner to Governor DeSantis and to stop the indoctrination of our children, and I will be that partner to him.”_ _“As we continue canvassing the district and attending numerous weekly events, our message continues to resonate that my campaign and candidacy is one that is unapologetically pro-life, pro-DeSantis, pro-term limits, and pro-2nd Amendment.” “We’ll continue to work hard every day to get this message to the voters.”_

* Republicans voted **NO** on marriage equality.
* Republicans voted **NO** on access to contraception.

name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Sign the petition to Congress: End legal immunity for gun manufacturers
body:
They’ve escaped responsibility for far too long
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, We all know that you can’t take a bottle of vodka and use it to mow down a dozen people in cold blood at a gym, a shopping mall, or a 4th of July parade. But there are a lot of places in this country where a bottle of vodka is harder to get than a sniper rifle. Why is that? It’s because **conservatives in Congress passed a law to shield gun manufacturers from liability**. Sound stupid? Yeah, we thought so too. Will you join us in asking Congress to fix this insane loophole? **[Tell Congress: End legal immunity for gun manufacturers.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tedf59662-9259-4cca-a88c-c221a19f0912/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** At a time when mass shootings occur multiple times a week, survivors and their families are unable to sue gun manufacturers for justice. We are tired of mourning while gun manufacturers put profits before people. **[Tell your members of Congress to repeal the Protection of Lawful Commerce of Arms Act.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T161f6cfd-b338-4424-8daf-1294be9f9e8d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

Since launching Stand For America PAC, we’ve endorsed and supported nearly 50 strong conservative candidates. We could not have been able to do this without support from people like you. It’s about replacing failed leadership with a strong conservative agenda that will lift up all Americans. It’s going to take every person stepping up to make this happen. subject: A new chapter for our organization

body:
the game is changing
|

Friend,

Through the last rounds of this redistricting cycle, I’ve worked with our organizers to help produce the fairest maps in a generation. There’s plenty of work still to be done, but let’s take a moment and talk about our work.

I’ve worked with our team in states like North Carolina to mobilize voters to push for fair and inclusive maps and demand a transparent redistricting process. The fair maps movement, including our volunteers, helped lay the groundwork for courts to strike down gerrymandered Republican maps in states like Alabama, Ohio, and North Carolina -- some of which are still being litigated. We’re fighting for maps in which everyone can fairly participate in the American government.

**But the game is changing.**

Redistricting has always been tied to American democracy. Yet with new threats like the U.S. Supreme Court taking the “independent state legislature” theory case, _Moore v. Harper_ , the stakes are higher than ever. The primary focus of our work will always be redistricting, but we know we can’t stop there.

[**With new challenges, we’re going to need more resources. Our fundraising goal for July is $30,000. We need all the help we can get. body:
We all have a role to play during this critical midterm election year.
#
I'm taking a very quick break from campaigning ahead of my primary on Tuesday to personally reaching out to our top supporters — including you, Peter. I want to ask: [**can chip in to fuel my campaign and help us hit our pre-primary fundraising goal?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14619?refcode=em20220730-1468&t=1&akid=1468%2E420207%2EhUngug)
**We know what challenge we're facing:** Corporate lobbyists and Republicans continue their work to stymie our progressive agenda and enrich themselves. Republicans are running against me in WA-7 — we must defeat them on Tuesday and again in November.
**We also know how we can fix it:** By protecting our Democratic majority and expanding our progressive coalition in Congress, we'll be even closer to advancing transformative legislation that invests in working people — like Medicare for All, protecting and expanding Social Security, and so much more. We must redouble our organizing and campaigning right now and through Election Day. The only way we'll be able to do it is with grassroots support.
[**Will you please make a donation of $3 or any amount today to help us reach our $30,000 July email fundraising goal before tomorrow at 11:59 PM? I'm counting on supporters like you to make sure we don't fall short.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14619?refcode=em20220730-1468&t=2&akid=1468%2E420207%2EhUngug)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/14619?refcode=em20220730-1468&t=21&akid=1468%2E420207%2EhUngug)**
Thanks for being on this team. We all have a role to play in this fight for working families, our communities, and our planet.
In solidarity,
Pramila

body:
The Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary James Judge received an endorsement from Community Patriots Tampa. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us16.campaign-archive.com/?e=00028e5542&u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=7accb1eb89)
---
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=88371d2859&e=00028e5542)
[**FL-14 frontrunner James Judge picks up endorsement from Community Patriots**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=9fae90f75b&e=00028e5542)
_Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary James Judge received an endorsement from Community Patriots Tampa._ TAMPA, Fla. – The Republican leader in the primary race in Florida’s 14th Congressional District has been endorsed by the well-known grassroots conservative organization Community Patriots Tampa, the campaign announced Friday.“James Judge is a Tampa local and a strong conservative, and we are honored to endorse him in his race for Florida’s 14th Congressional District,” said Jeff Hawks, founder of the group. “James shares our beliefs in strong conservative values like supporting law and order, protecting our Second Amendment from unconstitutional "gun grabs", reducing the federal debt and providing solutions for America’s inflation crisis.”Judge is running to unseat incumbent Democrat Kathy Castor, who notoriously supports soft-on-crime policies like defunding the police, along with progressive policies like unfettered abortion, gun control and reckless spending.Judge happily accepted the endorsement from Community Patriots Tampa.“Community Patriots is a force for good in the Tampa area,” Judge said. “Now more than ever, we need strong grassroots organizations to band together and fight for our cause. Community Patriots does just that, and I’m looking forward to fighting alongside the group and its members. I thank them for their support, and I’m thrilled to have their endorsement.”Judge has also received support and endorsements from the Tampa Bay Times, legendary political consultant Roger Stone, Rep. Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. name: Laura Nevitt,  Keystone Progress
subject: Let's make sure democracy lives here.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
Dear Friend,

Pennsylvania is where democracy was born. Let's make sure it's not the state where democracy dies.

We are up against so many who are working overtime to strip us of our rights and to tear down our democracy. Our progressive movement needs every one of us to put in our all to make sure that our voices are not silenced and that each of our full humanity is recognized by the law.

Please stand with us today as we fuel the movement here in PA. We have one day left to meet our end-of-month goal. Can you help?

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=073022&amount=20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=073022&amount=20]

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=073022&amount=30 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=073022&amount=30]

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=073022&amount=40 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=073022&amount=40]

Whatever you can afford... [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=073022]

The list of adversity is LONG. We're facing the potential of Mastriano as our governor — a man who tried to take away our votes and who has shared antisemitic messaging online — and TV Dr. Oz, a Trump-endorsed New Jersey resident, as our next Senator. With Mastriano in power, we will lose any hope of progress and gain all of the promises of a loss of human rights and the democratic process. That's why we have to bolster progressive candidates up and down the ballot — to push back against their misguided and cruel plans.

We are strong though, and stronger together. Let's raise our voices and get out our votes.

Laura Nevitt
Executive Director
Keystone Progress

body:
We have been colleagues in the Senate and opponents in the congressional campaign | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48564141/358707328/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjgwNThmOC00ZTEwLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZbNVbr3HB65LkzIiUCgpL79UB3tyMROHvxa3daECZDU=&emci=3be8b67c-1910-ed11-b47a-281878b82c0f&emdi=0f8058f8-4e10-ed11-b47a-281878b82c0f&ceid=43402272) | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48564142/358707329/588155673?refcode=E17353-20220730-KeshaSurrogate-graphic-DeadlineEOM-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjgwNThmOC00ZTEwLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZbNVbr3HB65LkzIiUCgpL79UB3tyMROHvxa3daECZDU=) Peter, A large, politically diverse coalition has chosen Becca to be our first Congresswoman, not in spite of how they differ, but because of what they have in common: A deep sense that we can and _must_ see each other in our humanity before it’s too late. Vermonters are exhausted and frightened by what they see in Washington, and many see little opportunity for meaningful progress. for a firing zone, and likely it’s to make way for more illegal Israeli
settlements in occupied Palestine.^[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112866?refcode=em20220730-24508-el&t=1001&akid=24508%2E1203867%2E49O2Yf ]

This forced population replacement is ethnic cleansing, and it’s pushing
families into homelessness.

I’ve joined nearly 90 members of Congress in urging the President to
immediately stop the Israeli government’s forced expulsions of
Palestinians from the villages of Masafer Yatta.^[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112867?refcode=em20220730-24508-el&t=1002&akid=24508%2E1203867%2E49O2Yf ][ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112868?refcode=em20220730-24508-el&t=1003&akid=24508%2E1203867%2E49O2Yf ] Many of us have
also called for the State Department to launch an independent U.S.
investigation into the Israeli military’s recent assassination of
Palestinian-American journalist Shireen Abu Akleh.

As the only Palestinian-American member of Congress, I have been pushing
Congress and the Biden administration to support Palestinian demands for

Democrats have long taken the Hispanic vote for granted.
---
But a recent New York Times Siena College poll shows that ONLY 41% of Hispanics said they intended to vote for Democrats, a 9% drop from March.
---
_You want to know why this shift is happening?_
---
Republicans like myself focus on the positive aspects of America. I revere the American Dream.
---
Democrats, meanwhile, claim that America is a nightmare and always has been.
---
_Peter, I REFUSE to accept that this country is a fundamentally bad place. There is nowhere else in the world where my story would be possible._
---
My parents came from Mexico, went through the immigration process, learned English, and became American citizens.
---
The other day, my dad summed it up perfectly.
---
He asked me “Where else in the world would it be possible to have our story?” _Where else could the son of an immigrant bus driver become a member of Congress?_
---
These are the types of opportunities that our country offers, and it’s amazing.
---
Hispanics are naturally conservative. We love this country. We don’t believe in socialism, open-borders, defunding the police, or any of the crazy ideas being pushed by the far-Left.
---
As the Democrats move to the political extremes, more and more Hispanics are realizing that the Republican Party is the right choice to get our country back on track.
---

clean_body: Hispanics are abandoning the Democrat party in record numbers. | Peter, I recently went on Fox News to speak about the political realignment America is experiencing. For decades, Hispanics have been considered a lock for the Democrat party – but increasing numbers of Hispanic Americans are leaving the Democrats and voting Republican. Just look at the recent special election results in Texas, where Republican Mayra Flores flipped a majority Hispanic district near the border for the first time in 100 years. We have an amazing opportunity to capture the Hispanic vote, and we’ve made great strides attracting the Hispanic voters that have been left behind by the Democrats’ far-Left policies. But to fully fund our efforts to win the Hispanic vote in this battleground district and grow the Republican Party, we have to put up high numbers at the upcoming end-of-month deadline and we’re depending on your support. Democrats have long taken the Hispanic vote for granted. But a recent New York Times Siena College poll shows that ONLY 41% of Hispanics said they intended to vote for Democrats, a 9% drop from March. You want to know why this shift is happening? Republicans like myself focus on the positive aspects of America. I revere the American Dream. Democrats, meanwhile, claim that America is a nightmare and always has been. Peter, I REFUSE to accept that this country is a fundamentally bad place. There is nowhere else in the world where my story would be possible. My parents came from Mexico, went through the immigration process, learned English, and became American citizens. The other day, my dad summed it up perfectly. He asked me “Where else in the world would it be possible to have our story?” Where else could the son of an immigrant bus driver become a member of Congress? These are the types of opportunities that our country offers, and it’s amazing. Hispanics are naturally conservative. We love this country. We don’t believe in socialism, open-borders, defunding the police, or any of the crazy ideas being pushed by the far-Left. As the Democrats move to the political extremes, more and more Hispanics are realizing that the Republican Party is the right choice to get our country back on track. Our message of hope and opportunity is resonating. But we need your help to get it before Hispanic voters here in this battleground district. Thank you, Juan Ciscomani Republican Candidate for Congress PAID FOR BY CISCOMANI FOR CONGRESS P.O. Box 35103 Tucson, AZ 85740

Peter,

The fight for racial, social and economic reforms to our justice system as well as the intense national attention on gun violence in recent years, reminds us that _our work is far from over._

Let me give you the statistics:

**Every year, over 100,000 people are shot in this country – that’s more than 300 Americans every single day.

There have already been almost 300 mass shootings in 2022, including at least 27 shootings at schools.**

name: Kelly Hall, Executive Director
subject: Health care is how I — and the Fairness Project — both got our start
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Fairness Project
body:
https://www.thefairnessproject.org/ [https://www.thefairnessproject.org/]
Friend,

What you may not know is just how special of a place health care holds in our hearts here at the Fairness Project. As a matter of fact, it’s how I — and Fairness Project — both got our start.

Long before joining the Fairness Project team, I got my start on Capitol Hill. I worked with a number of influential changemakers, but under Rep. Allyson Schwartz I had the unforgettable opportunity to work with a team of colleagues to draft and pass the Affordable Care Act. To this day, I still consider this to be one of the most foundational experiences of my career.

Fast forward to 2017 — Fairness Project had just won its first slate of campaigns ever in the 2016 election cycle. Up until then, our team had really only focused on campaigns to raise wages, but this year... we decided to grow our mission to support another cause that badly needed our help: health care access.

In 2017, we partnered with workers in Maine to win the first ever ballot measure campaign to successfully expand Medicaid access. It was in that moment, we knew: we could really do this.

Since then we’ve taken our fight to several states — all red and purple — and regardless of where voters fell on the political spectrum, friend, we won. We won because when it comes to kitchen table issues that affect everyone , time and again, voters will choose progress.

This work helped us crack the code and power progress in other states across the country. It’s helped us expand health care access to over 875,000 Americans and change the lives of 18 million people.

This year, we’re continuing the charge in South Dakota, where Medicaid expansion is on the ballot. So today, as we celebrate Medicaid’s 57th birthday, we focus on the work there still is do to — in South Dakota and across the country.

This work will only be possible with your support, friend. If you’re with us in the fight to expand access to life-saving health care, please consider donating to power our work today. I’ve included my personal donate link below, and I hope to see your contribution come through tonight.

body:
I’d like to introduce myself, and ask for some help before tomorrow ends.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=732%2E61531%2ElOSQcV)
Hi there,
My name’s Miles and I’m the new Organizing Director for the Peter Welch for Senate campaign.
As of today, there are only 10 days until the primary and only 100 days until the midterm election, so I’ve got some ambitious goals, and even more ambitious timelines.
Up to the primary and through the next 100 days, our team will be running a statewide field program, hiring and training organizers, recruiting and mobilizing hundreds of volunteers, and building relationships with local constituency groups. Together this work is designed to build a grassroots campaign that sends Peter Welch to the Senate so he can pass progressive policies for Vermont.
It’s a lot and, I’ll be honest, we could use some help funding this critical work. [**Before our July deadline ends tomorrow, can you chip in to help cover the cost of these organizing team needs?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3638?t=3&akid=732%2E61531%2ElOSQcV)
Here’s a glimpse of what’s on our list:
1. 14 clipboards for the team leaders in every county in Vermont.
2. 100 pens for upcoming events where volunteers will ask their fellow Vermonters to commit to vote.
3. Pancake mix and maple syrup for breakfast meetings Peter has with constituents. (Who doesn’t love pancakes?)
4. Envelopes to send our reminders to vote.
5. A stapler for each field office; Peter has actionable plans for the issues that matter most to Vermonters—plans that sometimes take up many, many pages.

We’re not asking for your donations to go off and do something mysterious with them. These are real needs for a hard-working field program.
These next 100 days will be a sprint, and my team needs all the help we can get. [**Please, pitch in before tomorrow’s deadline and help this grassroots campaign reach as many voters as we can.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3638?t=4&akid=732%2E61531%2ElOSQcV)
Thanks so much for your support,
Miles McGuriman, Organizing Director
Welch for Vermont

clean_body: I’d like to introduce myself, and ask for some help before tomorrow ends. Hi there, My name’s Miles and I’m the new Organizing Director for the Peter Welch for Senate campaign. As of today, there are only 10 days until the primary and only 100 days until the midterm election, so I’ve got some ambitious goals, and even more ambitious timelines. Up to the primary and through the next 100 days, our team will be running a statewide field program, hiring and training organizers, recruiting and mobilizing hundreds of volunteers, and building relationships with local constituency groups. Together this work is designed to build a grassroots campaign that sends Peter Welch to the Senate so he can pass progressive policies for Vermont. It’s a lot and, I’ll be honest, we could use some help funding this critical work. Here’s a glimpse of what’s on our list: 1. 14 clipboards for the team leaders in every county in Vermont. 2. 100 pens for upcoming events where volunteers will ask their fellow Vermonters to commit to vote. 3. Pancake mix and maple syrup for breakfast meetings Peter has with constituents. (Who doesn’t love pancakes?) 4. Envelopes to send our reminders to vote. 5. A stapler for each field office; Peter has actionable plans for the issues that matter most to Vermonters—plans that sometimes take up many, many pages. We’re not asking for your donations to go off and do something mysterious with them. These are real needs for a hard-working field program. These next 100 days will be a sprint, and my team needs all the help we can get. Thanks so much for your support, Miles McGuriman, Organizing Director Welch for Vermont | | | | ---|---|--- PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT Welch for Vermont P.O Box 909 Richmond, VT 05477

subject: Prayer Call Tonight
body:
Join The Prayer Call

| [ ](http://www.ralphrebandtforgovernor.com/?e=35c30c37841d37cfa9d73635bc93e640&utm_source=ralphrebandtforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=prayer_call_2&n=1)

**Join The Prayer Call Tonight** **Tonight, Saturday 9:30pm** **Call 605-313-4829** **Then enter 694177#** For anyone who would like to join in Praying and Fasting, we have a team that will be praying and fasting the entire day of the election. Here are some things that we can flood the throne of God with together, as we join together- \- Father, Son Jesus Christ, and Holy Spirit, we acknowledge and glorify you as God, we give you Praise. \- We confess our shortcomings, and ask your forgiveness. \- We are SO THANKFUL Lord that you have brought us this far! \- Lord, Ralph meets the qualifications of whom You Lord have said you will look to in Isaiah 66. The one who is humble, contrite in spirit, and trembles at Your Word. Please Lord, as we your people ask in agreement, please listen to the voice of Your children in Michigan as we ask for our choice for Governor in Michigan to be Ralph Rebandt. Lord, the only reason we ask this so passionately of You is that we believe He is Your choice as he meets these qualifications. Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven, Lord. We believe You are Able! \- That every heart and every mind that is able to vote will hear about Ralph, and be inclined to vote for him. \- That God would appoint 'an east wind' when the sun rises on election day, bringing about a miraculous win for Ralph on August 2nd, 2022. \- That God would work with wave upon wave in the hearts and minds of each voter, with an overflow of what is needed to win this election. \- That God would use everything- individual efforts, letters to churches, flyers in car handles and windows, commercials, text messages, rallies, people, radio, and Anything else possible to get Ralph to the seat of Governor in Michigan if it is His Will. Ralph desires Psalm 138:2, "Your Name and Your Word you have elevated above all else." \- That the Holy Spirit would make up ALL the difference in our weaknesses in how we do not know how to pray- "Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words." (Romans 8:26) Holy Spirit, please intercede Yourself for us in this area of prayer as you have promised to do. May the Will of the Father be done, in Jesus Name. Praise God, from Whom All Blessings Flow. Lord, we look to You. In Jesus Name, Amen! Thank you for your continued support. Ralph Rebandt For Governor

subject: A broken Congress betrayed our veterans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Molly for Vermont
body:
Republicans voted down the The PACT Act to provide veterans health care.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48562967/358702899/196037868?sourceid=1071963&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxN2U2MjY1Yy00YTEwLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODJjMGYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_saXLFZ1JwTTCuuNNremv7-p2s6U6S6d__lhzMsC98c=&emci=d31e38a1-4810-ed11-b47a-281878b82c0f&emdi=17e6265c-4a10-ed11-b47a-281878b82c0f&ceid=43402276) | Peter, This week, Republicans in the US Senate let party politics and political stunts stand in the way of urgently needed support for our veterans exposed to burn pits. The PACT Act would provide health care and benefits to roughly 3.5 million veterans injured by exposure to toxic substances during their service. This bill had already passed the Senate by a resounding, bipartisan 84-14 vote in June; due to a technical language error, it had to be voted on again. What was different this time around was that, hours before the PACT Act came to the floor, Democrats had reached a momentous agreement on healthcare and climate action. This time, the PACT Act failed 55-42 because of retaliation by Republicans. **This is outrageous.** Vermont National Guard members, enlisted service members, veterans, and their families will suffer. As the proud sister of an Iraq war veteran, I feel this insult. Earlier this month, when I unveiled my veterans’ affairs agenda at a press conference in Colchester, I referred specifically to the PACT Act as a legislative priority. At that time, the bill appeared to be on a glide path to passage this session. Now – the cowardice of partisanship has likely delayed legislative action until the next Congress. While we wait for a new Congress to be elected, countless veterans will needlessly suffer – physically and financially – from injuries sustained in service to our country. **We don’t have time for partisan stunts.** In Congress, I won’t be afraid to put party politics aside. I will work day in and day out to heal our democracy and bridge the divide. I will never lose sight of the needs of Vermonters – and I’ll keep fighting for the support Vermont veterans and service members deserve. Yours, _Molly_

The stakes of this election could not be higher. Jena is running against a candidate who is funded by a dark money SuperPAC. Pam Anderson refused to support the Colorado Votes Act in 2019, a bill that expanded voter access and drop boxes across the state.
That is why I’m reaching out. We need to come together to defeat Pam Anderson. Can you rush in a donation right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2207-q3-jg-eom?refcode=220730-email]

| | Fellow American,

When I dropped out of high school at the age of 17, my parents said, “If you're going to stop going to school, you got to start going to work.”

_I immediately got a job and started waitressing at Waffle House._

In my years since then, I've worked a lot of jobs and worn a lot of different hats – author, business-owner, waitress, marketer, commercial real-estate agent, mother, and now I serve as the Congresswoman for South Carolina's first district. **But I'll never forget the lessons I learned at my first job: work hard, do right by others, listen more than you talk, and never stop fighting for what you believe in.**

If we haven't met yet, [**I'm Nancy Mace**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=674cbebcb83e4c9ba3269af1de3e89f2&_e=IaKQJA-CdQp-DcYJGyLHAyPZpAkv8BBf3xf89SYp7hKDoKobigLK3UmHKnJNLZlwYAXC35kn2UfjtpPtJ3gvlP71cklfDZdNxK2Iux4alHBjISUjVILqrda3QBnC21P_1C1-iCTNUPy0IyWWxcu9MVzU-eqYMOCW6-GK9Hbi_tSz5kTEv40vL3HQUVcMQFj6BbHvM-SKB_TYmRPvy_L88m4Zf2vdYgtUrzaeQXlI38ql4pTUNZD0U7AZUvlWvSBrFyUDKt1npcFNBFgkBBN36pYectlCGKOQLwh4u_VwAD15rpTo2jOVKPvotIbRJlqrzK_EKcCRHB0ppvwYvkYN6PEzkFX6GQDdRdwSaZUxQ7t6pC-D8x10ZkdsEHGJGkVQyE16a5c9wpocLJ7eGWdGPFMTXNRMUNh7LBDnsSizm8hOYbBaCLabAiVsQhFBBSXopUuwPxA1sxIpn-i3qNZz9A%3D%3D). I'm a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America!

I don't have your typical run of the mill story because I'm not your typical Congresswoman. I ran for Congress because someone had to stand up and fight to protect the freedoms we have in our country and to serve the people of South Carolina.

In 2020, we took this seat back from the Democrats and now, we are fighting tooth and nail to keep it Red.

**I'm extremely proud of the work we've accomplished, but there's still so much to do. So, I want to make sure you are still on my team as[we continue on the path to re-election](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=674cbebcb83e4c9ba3269af1de3e89f2&_e=IaKQJA-CdQp-DcYJGyLHAyPZpAkv8BBf3xf89SYp7hKDoKobigLK3UmHKnJNLZlwYAXC35kn2UfjtpPtJ3gvlP71cklfDZdNxK2Iux4alHBjISUjVILqrda3QBnC21P_1C1-iCTNUPy0IyWWxcu9MVzU-eqYMOCW6-GK9Hbi_tSz5kTEv40vL3HQUVcMQFj6BbHvM-SKB_TYmRPvy_L88m4Zf2vdYgtUrzaeQXlI38ql4pTUNZD0U7AZUvlWvSBrBys_rlsaQnsLv50Yq6q_kWsV535qNKh6XnuvIROCXhj8_XAKY6eVXSvK5Y_T-Y4v5Ygp-yyjN2GCxbJDmnlDztgpejvDVd_82nhF5GhVTazAnaOwz0vCkoxQwsIAjw9_QPO6z4NkYu9X5dukqnR37dToNXSEWCSiOsUwgjMBgvRLlRM-32SmKkqKllshy6jezWTXHx6yL18K5wQ7ZQRHcw%3D%3D).**

[**Will you chip in whatever you can – whether it's $75, $50, or $10, so that I can win this race and restore our country.**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=674cbebcb83e4c9ba3269af1de3e89f2&_e=IaKQJA-CdQp-DcYJGyLHAyPZpAkv8BBf3xf89SYp7hKDoKobigLK3UmHKnJNLZlwYAXC35kn2UfjtpPtJ3gvlP71cklfDZdNxK2Iux4alHBjISUjVILqrda3QBnC21P_1C1-iCTNUPy0IyWWxcu9MVzU-eqYMOCW6-GK9Hbi_tSz5kTEv40vL3HQUVcMQFj6BbHvM-SKB_TYmRPvy_L88m4Zf2vdYgtUrzaeQXlI38ql4pTUNZD0U7AZUvlWvSBr5Mdnt8qNVXwTiobBSw6WIFydPy04c-R-gH-VxXVk00ksV6pgZMcvghwf_lm9LR9z4SlWrBO9bTlW0KLho2M_LoeV7ZdiVuJhji2iuwJyn0TJZWZg3JaKqTkPPz-5tdd49TMECH9P_aMmVKzl8jtQBVBZeh5zY11m2sftYiaBlCvCmRGUr65kqPi8qlaPYIKkJAsiY155vqmvu06cpg9oSQ%3D%3D)

There was a time in my life when I never thought I'd get a high school diploma, _let alone graduate from The Citadel, one day start a company, and now serve in Congress._

I made a promise to myself when I won two years ago that I would be fiscally conservative; I would be an independent voice and I wouldn't toe the party line especially when Republicans spent too much and taxed too much.

I'm proud of my conservative record and I'm proud of delivering results day in and day out for the Lowcountry. I'm proud I've never voted to raise your taxes. And as the daughter of a veteran, I'm proud of the work I've done to help our veterans throughout South Carolina. **Serving the Lowcountry is the honor of my lifetime.**

[**_Which is why I'm asking for your help to continue doing my job and serving you._** ](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=674cbebcb83e4c9ba3269af1de3e89f2&_e=IaKQJA-CdQp-DcYJGyLHAyPZpAkv8BBf3xf89SYp7hKDoKobigLK3UmHKnJNLZlwYAXC35kn2UfjtpPtJ3gvlP71cklfDZdNxK2Iux4alHBjISUjVILqrda3QBnC21P_1C1-iCTNUPy0IyWWxcu9MVzU-eqYMOCW6-GK9Hbi_tSz5kTEv40vL3HQUVcMQFj6BbHvM-SKB_TYmRPvy_L88m4Zf2vdYgtUrzaeQXlI38ql4pTUNZD0U7AZUvlWvSBrZDi13f6IehlP339IQ8kyJTVLM6ieaew6JODxC_vAcQBT408ABSuDHWipSHAU9ywzzUBL51NFsYQA0dpmdbB0Bdz_YDn79LbLNW6lddMHe9Jo6NHgYg5BH4GgWc2sZyF_rztzmarduEy3BDTMZRg8X__9S0b7ydHZJvqFHDmTOD48dtP8gM9KZPHROCS9uNcV6lTgoPKWLlKm39Rr1d8LCQ%3D%3D) [ ** KEEP THE FIRST ➞ **](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=674cbebcb83e4c9ba3269af1de3e89f2&_e=IaKQJA-CdQp-DcYJGyLHAyPZpAkv8BBf3xf89SYp7hKDoKobigLK3UmHKnJNLZlwYAXC35kn2UfjtpPtJ3gvlP71cklfDZdNxK2Iux4alHBjISUjVILqrda3QBnC21P_1C1-iCTNUPy0IyWWxcu9MVzU-eqYMOCW6-GK9Hbi_tSz5kTEv40vL3HQUVcMQFj6BbHvM-SKB_TYmRPvy_L88m4Zf2vdYgtUrzaeQXlI38ql4pTUNZD0U7AZUvlWvSBrvq7Lb8tOPN_mRZGeP9TVVnykTHq7eJROutrYGSAop7Vy12kbjznfz_zdtRZhJNnGmLHf9DjFhULlkWwF04yAmEcoWI17499Al1XO53qTH1YWAfj4Az5JBPnIhmCpvo6CZlm9gckAdWhGAFx-FcoOdV3oDQ7XphQqx2bIMI5XZdyRpfqE6kDANhrC1lUu1QaTqx1ZICAsVyQZH-R-oed7fw%3D%3D)

What's happening in America right now is _horrifying_. Kids are being used as political pawns, radical liberal ideas are becoming mainstream, the woke media is prioritizing clicks and view over the truth, and our so-called ‘leaders' have sold themselves out for fame and fortune.

As Americans, we deserve __so much better than this__. It's time to restore our economy, secure the southern border, put parents back in charge, support our military, and reestablish pride in our country.

[**It's time to stand up and say enough is enough! I'm running for re-election because I believe I'm the woman who can help save our country.**](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=674cbebcb83e4c9ba3269af1de3e89f2&_e=IaKQJA-CdQp-DcYJGyLHAyPZpAkv8BBf3xf89SYp7hKDoKobigLK3UmHKnJNLZlwYAXC35kn2UfjtpPtJ3gvlP71cklfDZdNxK2Iux4alHBjISUjVILqrda3QBnC21P_1C1-iCTNUPy0IyWWxcu9MVzU-eqYMOCW6-GK9Hbi_tSz5kTEv40vL3HQUVcMQFj6BbHvM-SKB_TYmRPvy_L88m4Zf2vdYgtUrzaeQXlI38ql4pTUNZD0U7AZUvlWvSBrjoJNjl0Fb17Ujfs94bICIZMhjP-oMccsbJz2aowp5DhhmDl5shv0e7nf7ivZVo04ipoq54pezPvGyUaNO-80TgP0mkdhRsoG3BVkGnGbagEd_6tTNgF19_ZJteHImU67prDOKhHovCxo5c0G7ZqzDzVe7njsxCYkeFfK7iiocjBwHyHaRJ70b6SOjbLnb43UfFHeJ3xQd5zp2KQVkbxY1w%3D%3D) I'm in Washington week in and week out, fighting for you and your family – I have a 100% record of voting to lower taxes and a 100% lifetime rating with Conservation Voters of South Carolina!

[ ** SEND NANCY TO CONGRESS ➞ **](http://links.americansfordjt.com/u/click?_t=aff9c7dfb71242f8abc6b00341ebfdb2&_m=674cbebcb83e4c9ba3269af1de3e89f2&_e=IaKQJA-CdQp-DcYJGyLHAyPZpAkv8BBf3xf89SYp7hKDoKobigLK3UmHKnJNLZlwYAXC35kn2UfjtpPtJ3gvlP71cklfDZdNxK2Iux4alHBjISUjVILqrda3QBnC21P_1C1-iCTNUPy0IyWWxcu9MVzU-eqYMOCW6-GK9Hbi_tSz5kTEv40vL3HQUVcMQFj6BbHvM-SKB_TYmRPvy_L88m4Zf2vdYgtUrzaeQXlI38ql4pTUNZD0U7AZUvlWvSBriVTjLE__IspMOm3Er5mj9LA--yn4uiQssV3nkaHlwHaDwdcE7u7RAF4WA-FHFsxHgvGNfCEXgj5HbFcU6V9NSyUsLocyfD8JRAlfKheppsiss5swwI_lgyG_PRsrZtRMmfp4vAR2P7zW_BcrfXWNufty6vTt6NMstpVpFf1WcBJLhpk70wNp6nE2nsMIWu9itPJF707DFnxlSxd1znbeBg%3D%3D)

# About Nancy
---

Uhhhhhhh
#
Derek,
We’re really gonna miss Senator Pat Toomey. (LOL just kidding)
_Senator who?_ Uhhh... This dude. 👇
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220730-3?refcode=em20220730-6700&refcode2=6700_434096_lwJo6T&akid=6700%2E434096%2ElwJo6T)
**I’m sure you already know how bad Pat Toomey is.**
In the last few weeks alone, Toomey has refused to say if he’ll support a bill protecting marriage equality and just helped tank a bill that would guarantee life-saving care for veterans harmed by burn pits and toxins.
As Jon Stewart said, Pat Toomey is using our veterans as “pawns.” That’s just sickening.
And please keep in mind, this dude’s been in the Senate for 11 years!!! I don’t think I could even fit all of his BS into one email, frankly. 🙄🙄🙄
But the #1 thing you need to know about Pat Toomey is this: **He is NOT seeking re-election, which is why I’m now running against Dr. Oz to win Pennsylvania’s open Senate seat.**
So, today, I’m humbly asking:
**[_Will you please make your first donation of $5 or more toward our $1,000,000 end-of-month goal now? This is our chance to replace Pat Toomey with a fighter for working families + add Pennsylvania’s open Senate seat to our razor-thin Democratic majority._](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220730-3?refcode=em20220730-6700&refcode2=6700_434096_lwJo6T&akid=6700%2E434096%2ElwJo6T)**

__
The last time this Senate seat was contested, it ended up being the most expensive Senate race of the 2016 campaign cycle.
So, with how crucial (and flippable) this seat is, **we know the GOP is willing to spend as much money as possible to make sure we don’t win.** After all, Dr. Oz is literally worth $100-$400 million thanks to his years hawking snake oil on TV. He can more or less write blank checks to his own campaign.
Supporters like you are helping us fight back against the buckets of money the GOP and their super PACs are dumping into PA. But we can’t afford to lose momentum if we want to make sure they don’t buy this seat.
**[_Let’s show them what our grassroots movement is made of. Will you chip in your first $5 now?_](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220730-3?refcode=em20220730-6700&refcode2=6700_434096_lwJo6T&akid=6700%2E434096%2ElwJo6T)**

Thanks for all you do,
John

subject: Make no mistake: North Carolina is our best path to expanding the Senate majority.

body:
Cheri Beasley understands what’s at stake, and she’s made clear that she will not hesitate to cast the decisive vote in the U.S. Senate.
#

I'm furious. Our freedoms and future are under attack from Republicans and a politicized Supreme Court majority. But where is the sense of urgency for what’s at stake in this moment?
Cheri Beasley understands what’s at stake, and she’s made clear that she will not hesitate to cast the decisive vote for progress in the U.S. Senate.
Make no mistake: Our best path to progress is expanding the Senate majority by helping Cheri flip this seat. There are few bigger priorities this November for those of us that want to make real change.
If you want the Senate gridlock to end, then [**please make a $3 donation to Cheri Beasley’s campaign before her July deadline. I won’t mince words here: Representation matters.
If we want to effect real, lasting change, we need to take a hard look at who is at the decision-making table in Washington — and whose voices are missing. Just look at Cheri’s impact on the North Carolina Supreme Court. It took her leadership as Chief Justice for the court to finally create a paid family leave policy.
Cheri Beasley is exactly the type of leader who we need fighting alongside us to pass legislation that addresses the real challenges facing working families today. On paid family leave, reproductive freedom, voting rights, and more, Cheri is someone that we can count on to be a voice for the people.

| | | Peter Willis,

They've reached an all time low.

Gov. Greg Gianforte and his pal Matt Rosendale have been putting up a big fight to prevent federal dollars to increase access to high-speed internet from being spent in Montana.

[Via Montana Public Radio](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=e8e3c1c899&e=2f4ec52c5e): "Vice President Kamala Harris wrote a letter to Gov. Greg Gianforte this week saying as many as 151,000 Montana households are still eligible for discounted internet service. The program offers eligible participants a $30 per month discount on their internet bills, and $75 per month for households on tribal lands."

[__**Will you chip in $50 to help me make sure federal dollars for broadband are spent on hard-working Montanans? **__](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=984ffdc087&e=2f4ec52c5e)

| | | Dear Peter,

It’s another summer with yet another dangerous wildfire burning tens of thousands of acres right in our own backyard, and experts are already calling the _Oak Fire_ California’s largest wildfire of the year so far. Over 3,000 residents have been evacuated and the sad reality is that many won’t have homes to return to once the blaze is extinguished.

**Bottom line: Climate change is only worsening the threat of wildfires, and we need bold climate action – now -– to protect our planet for future generations.**

[Peter, if you’re ready to send a climate champion and proven progressive to Congress to fight for a _Green New Deal_ with a robust jobs training program, click here to chip in whatever you can to my campaign.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=5d8f408a90&e=292fde286a)

As Assembly Speaker pro Tem, I passed a $3.7 billion package to combat climate change, authored the bill to create _OneShoreline_ to fight sea level rise, and helped secure the largest climate investment in California history. I pushed for clean-energy transit initiatives like _CalTrain_ electrification and zero-emission buses and wrote the _Climate Resilience Bond_ to protect our natural resources.

In Congress, I am ready to build on these accomplishments and prioritize passing a _Green New Deal_ to safeguard our planet for future generations and reduce emissions while also strengthening the American workforce with good-paying, middle-class, union jobs in the clean energy sector.

[But I need your help to get there, and my campaign has only one day left to hit our July fundraising goal. Will you help us before this critical deadline with a gift of $30, $50, or $150 today?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=220f41ccd5&e=292fde286a)

Onward,

Kevin Mullin
